scope: Michigan concealed pistol license; research input only, not runtime admission

statutoryAccessLimit.result: Official Legislature HTML and PDF endpoints returned HTTP 403. Statutory text not independently verified; quoted agency guidance is the evidence below.

authority.quote: The applicant must file this application with the county clerk in the county in which he or she resides.
authority.runtimeLimit: An actual saved county-clerk issuing authority binding is required. County government alone does not establish that the clerk exists or has issued a license.

processing.unit: days after classifiable fingerprints are taken
processing.quote: The county clerk shall issue a license or notice of statutory disqualification within 45 days after the date the applicant has classifiable fingerprints taken.
processing.trigger: actual classifiable-fingerprint capture, following paid fees and filed application
notSupported: an invented fingerprint completion or background-check clearance

conditions: No license or notice of statutory disqualification issued within the stated interval
Actual qualifying fingerprint receipt for the named individual
Receipt carried with official state-issued driver license or personal identification card
receiptRule.meaning: Agency guidance says the qualifying receipt serves as a CPL until the clerk issues a license or disqualification notice. This is distinct from an issued permit record.
receiptRule.runtimeLimit: Require saved receipt, date, identity/document facts and absence of actual issued disqualification; do not infer these from an application.

minimumAge.quote: Be at least 21 years of age.

felonyExclusion.quote: Have never been convicted of a felony in Michigan or elsewhere, and a felony charge against the applicant is not pending in Michigan or elsewhere at the time he or she applies for a CPL.
felonyExclusion.runtimeLimit: Generic crime:assault/robbery/burglary/vandalism or a sentence without classification does not establish felony status or a complete criminal-record check. Relief/expungement exceptions not independently researched in this packet.

initialApplication.otherEligibility: Age and conviction checks alone are incomplete. MSP also lists citizenship/lawful admission, residency and waivers, training, firearm possession restrictions, orders/mental-health/legal incapacity conditions, dishonorable discharge, identification and federal NICS prohibition. No absence of disqualifying facts is inferred.

fee.per: application and licensing fee payable to county clerk
fee.runtimeLimit: Not a guessed total cost: fingerprint/training and other applicable fees are not priced here.

renewal.applicationWindow: Not more than six months before, nor one year after, current CPL expiration
renewal.validity: Until birthday not less than four nor more than five years after issuance or renewal; birthday-derived expiry, not a fixed four-year timer
renewal.timelyApplication: Before expiry, existing license extends until renewal license or disqualification notice; actual clerk receipt plus expired license must be carried
renewal.lateApplication: After expiry, no concealed carry until renewal license issued
renewal.fingerprints: Repeat fingerprints not required if previously submitted and maintained by MSP
renewal.processingDeadline: This renewal guidance does not supply a renewal processing deadline; do not copy initial fingerprint-triggered 45 days.
